messages:
mike: Quick async standup — yesterday: finished draft for the benchmarks post (finalized numbers + screenshots), filed PR for the long-form launch blog, and synced with design on hero assets. Blockers: waiting on ENG review for the benchmark repro script and a quick CTA copy approval. Today: pinging for reviews, prepping calendar entries, and scheduling the post if we get thumbs-up. @sam can you eyeball the reproducibility notes?
maria: looks good — can you paste the CTA options here? i'm leaning toward the shorter one. also can you add a TL;DR at top for execs? :tada:
mike: CTA options: 1) "Try Redwood Optimize" 2) "See the cost breakdown" 3) "Start a free benchmark" — short one is #1. TL;DR: 1–2 lines focused on cost + latency wins, i'll add.
sam: on it. i'll review the repro script in the PR now. heads-up: might suggest a small change to the perf chart labels.
priya: for launch timing — can we aim to publish Wed AM PST? marketing ops prefers morning for APAC reach. if ENG can clear by EOD tomorrow i can schedule.
emily: calendar updated: https://calendar.redwood.ai/marketing/benchmarks (added a stub event Wed 09:00 PST). I've left the description with the PR link and image checklist.
lucas: reduced hero PNG from 1.8MB to 420KB and updated the google fonts fallback. should help page speed. confirmed alt text present.
content-bot: scheduled-draft (mike) created: /drafts/benchmarks-2026-03-18 — reminder set for 24h before publish.
mike: thanks @lucas! @sam — ping again if you need me to tweak the repro steps. if you approve, i'll merge and @priya can action scheduling.
sam: quick note in the PR — fixed a flaky shell command and added a reproducible seed. approved and left a small comment on the chart legend. :white_check_mark:
priya: perfect, i'm slotting it for Wed 09:00 PST and will queue the social assets. mike, can you drop the final hero URL and canonical in the event description?
mike: final hero: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/bench-hero-v3.png — canonical set. done.
emily: added the social checklist and preview screenshots to the event. tagging @maria for copy QA tomorrow morning.
maria: will do a quick pass tomorrow AM. also, are we good on any legal/claims for the benchmark numbers? cc: @legal if needed.
lucas: numbers are from internal perf runs on ded-32 with quantized weights — i've added a footnote in the doc.
content-bot: publish-window: Wed 09:00 PST — queued for approval.
mike: great — thanks everyone. blockers cleared as long as no last-minute legal flags. i'll post a final confirm at EOD. :thumbsup:
emia: (typo) — ignore
priya: noted. if legal flags appear, we'll hold and move to Thu morning. otherwise see you all on launch.
mike: EOD check-in: no legal flags so far. merging in 10m and handing to @priya to push live.
content-bot: merged PR #452 by mike — draft status -> ready
priya: pushing live now. will update with live URL once published.
content-bot: publish-complete: benchmarks-post live at https://redwood.ai/blog/benchmarks-cost-latency (Wed 09:03 PST)
mike: live! adding to the release notes and sending a short announcer email. thanks team :rocket:
